groups.name: Panel collapse mechanism
groups.rationale: Introduces the core collapse functionality with state management, labels, badges, and detection of when the agent speaks.

groups.name: Responsive breakpoint calculation
groups.rationale: Updates the view format logic to account for panel collapse state, offering two different media query breakpoints based on whether the panel is open or shut.

groups.name: Panel rail UI component
groups.rationale: Creates the rail that stays on screen when the panel collapses, rendering state changes, handling the toggle click, and exposing methods to update the badge and force expand.

groups.name: Panel mount API change
groups.rationale: Refactors mountPanel to accept an options object and calls onPending whenever the unsent queue changes so the rail can display the count.

groups.name: View toggle responsiveness
groups.rationale: Changes the view toggle from consuming a media query directly to calling a hasRoom function, and returns a refresh method so the main script can trigger re-evaluation when the panel state changes.

groups.name: Main page wiring
groups.rationale: Extracts page element queries into readPage for safety, wires the rail and its callbacks, maintains two separate media queries for open and shut states, tracks panel collapse state, auto-expands when the agent speaks, and calls view.refresh when breakpoint state changes.

groups.name: Layout and styling
groups.rationale: Adds the rail column to the grid, hides the panel and shows a narrower grid when collapsed, truncates header text to prevent wrapping, and adjusts media queries to account for panel state.

groups.name: Server-side template
groups.rationale: Adds the rail button to the HTML template with the badge span and sets the initial data-panel attribute to 'open'.

groups.name: Task documentation
groups.rationale: Marks the panel collapse task complete and documents the implementation details: the rail width, the two breakpoints, the lack of persistence, and the header text truncation.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
